opportunities.name: Ryanair flight search and selection
opportunities.description: Search Ryanair for flights from {origin} to {destination} (return or one-way) on {dates} for {passengers}, optionally with a promo code, then select the outbound and return flights.
steps: Choose Return trip or One way
Click From field, choose origin country, then airport
Click To field, choose destination country, then airport
Open the date picker, go to the month and click the departure date
If return, click the return date
Open Passengers and adjust adults with +/-, then click Done
Optionally click Apply promo code and enter the code
Click Search
On results, click Select for the outbound flight
Click Select for the return flight and choose a fare

instances.values: Dublin -> Athens (Greece), return 2 Apr - 5 Apr, 1 adult, both flights selected
Tel Aviv -> Venice Treviso, return 9 May - 16 May, 1 adult, both flights selected, then fare choice
Dublin (Ireland) -> Paris Beauvais (France), return 26 Apr - 2 May, 2 adults, promo code 1000001

opportunities.name: Booking.com attraction ticket selection
opportunities.description: On Booking.com Attractions, find attractions in {destination} for {date}, optionally filter and sort, open an attraction, pick the date and ticket quantities, and click Next.
steps: Click the Attractions tab
Enter the destination or attraction name, or pick a destination tile
Open Select your dates and pick the date
Click Search
Optionally apply filters (free cancellation, city, category) and sort (Most popular)
Open the chosen attraction
Pick the date and time slot
Set ticket counts for adults, children and infants
Click Next

instances.values: Kyoto (via Asia tile), 25 May, filters: free cancellation, Kyoto, Tours; sort Most popular; Fushimi Inari Shrine Hiking Tour, 2 adults + 1 infant

opportunities.name: Resy restaurant search and set Notify
opportunities.description: On Resy, search for {restaurant}, open its page, set the date and party size, and set a Notify alert for the preferred time window.
steps: Click the search box and type the restaurant name
Pick the restaurant from the suggestions
Set the Date (and Guests) on the restaurant page
Click Notify for the slot or meal period
Set the preferred start and end times
Click Confirm

instances.values: Senyai Thai Kitchen (Pittsburgh), Thu 6 Apr, 2 guests, 5:00-7:00 PM
High Tide (Brooklyn), Mon 17 Apr, 2 guests, Lunch notify
